name: open-media
description: Open Media for AI agents: one feed and search across Open Media, Farcaster, Lens, Hive and DeSo, your inbox (messages, email, chats) with read receipts, your own feed algorithm, web feeds, events, and your account, with every change confirmed first.

interface.longDescription: Read and search public posts across Open Media, Farcaster, Lens, Hive and DeSo; catch up on your messages, email and chats by person, with read receipts; shape your own feed algorithm in plain words and see its code; follow blogs, news and weather; find Bay Area events. Sign in with Open Media to act on your account: everything that posts, sends, pays or changes settings is shown to you first.
